say:2:1720413001:1.text: Oh. It's you two. Funny, isn't it? Whole street full of people watching the show, and you're the only ones who actually came after them. Thanks.
say:2:1720413001:1.source_cn: 呼……是你们啊。刚才那么多在旁边看热闹的人，只有你们肯...

say:3:1720413002:1.text: And, ah... judging by your attire, miss, you must be a court mage. Sorry about this. I should've gotten those little devils under control before they started bothering the two of you.
say:3:1720413002:1.source_cn: 看这位小姐的衣着，您是宫廷魔法师吗？是我没用，让这两个...

say:4:1720413003:1.text: Can't believe I let them slip away right under my nose... That sewer's pitch-black, and too narrow for anyone to get through...
say:4:1720413003:1.source_cn: 可惜还是让它们逃掉了……这下水道又黑又窄，根本进不去……

say:5:1720413004:1.text: Ugh, just my luck. I knew I should've swapped shifts this morning! If I go back empty-handed, Lord Grandet's going to skin me alive!
say:5:1720413004:1.source_cn: 唉，太倒霉了，早知道今天就该跟人换班的！我就这么空手回...

choice_prompt:6:1720413004.text: Ugh, just my luck. I knew I should've swapped shifts this morning! If I go back empty-handed, Lord Grandet's going to skin me alive!
choice_prompt:6:1720413004.source_cn: 唉，太倒霉了，早知道今天就该跟人换班的！我就这么空手回去，那位葛朗台大人非得扒了我的皮不可！

say:7:1720413005:1.text: I'm helping too! But... how exactly are we getting in there?
say:7:1720413005:1.source_cn: 那我也来帮忙！可是我们要怎么进入下水道呢？

choice_prompt:8:1720413005.text: I'm helping too! But... how exactly are we getting in there?
choice_prompt:8:1720413005.source_cn: 那我也来帮忙！可是我们要怎么进入下水道呢？

say:10:1720413007:1.text: You can do transfiguration? That's incredible! Then... alright. I'll leave this to you.
say:10:1720413007:1.source_cn: 竟然有这么神奇的魔法？！太好了！那这件事就拜托两位了！

say:11:1720413008:1.text: I'll stay here and watch the entrance in case they try to sneak back out. Just be careful in there, alright?
say:11:1720413008:1.source_cn: 我就在入口这里守着，防止它们再从这里溜出来！请两位务必小心！

choice:8:0:1.text: If we can't fit through, maybe something smaller can.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 人进不去，别的动物应该可以
choice:8:0:1.male: If we can't fit through, maybe something smaller can.
choice:8:0:1.female: If we can't fit through, maybe something smaller can.

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 我帮你抓住这两个家伙
